sources.title: GitHub - yatheshl/Q-Learning-Taxi-v3: This project demonstrates the use ...
sources.snippet: The Taxi-v3 environment simulates a simple grid world where the agent (taxi) needs to pick up passengers from one location and drop them off at another while navigating obstacles on the grid. The agent learns to accomplish this task efficiently by employing Q-learning, a popular reinforcement learning algorithm.

sources.title: peter-z3ng/csci323-drive-a-taxi - GitHub
sources.snippet: A reinforcement learning project in OpenAI's Gym Taxi-v3 environment that trains an AI agent to pick up and drop off passengers using Q-learning while learning the optimal routes through exploration and rewards. Built using Python3, Gymnasium, Numpy, Matplotlib and tqdm.

sources.title: Mastering Q-Learning with the Fast-Taxi-v3 Model - fxis.ai
sources.snippet: In this post, we've explored how to implement and use a Q-learning agent in the Taxi-v3 environment. It's a powerful method that showcases the capabilities of reinforcement learning in navigating complex tasks. Remember, each ride teaches the agent something new—just like every coding challenge you tackle helps you become a better programmer!
